title: UniWAM: Unified World-Action Model
abstract: Vision-language-action models benefit from the understanding and reasoning capabilities of pretrained vision-language models, but action-only supervision provides limited grounding in world dynamics. Conversely, world-action models inherit spatiotemporal priors from video generation models, yet remain limited in semantic understanding and reasoning under distribution shifts. We introduce UniWAM, a unified architecture that integrates a physical reasoner, a world generator, and an action predictor to jointly learn semantic understanding of the physical world, visual generation, and action prediction. To ensure the quality of the training data, we developed a rigorous data cleaning and annotation pipeline for both human egocentric data and robot data. To adapt the vision-language component to embodied tasks while preserving its inherited language capabilities, we represent low-level actions in natural language and introduce a pre-training recipe that assigns complementary supervision from visual question answering (VQA) data, human egocentric data, and robot demonstrations to the appropriate model components. During post-training, future visual noise augmentation reduces reliance on precise future predictions, while history-conditioned flow matching uses encoded action history to initialize action generation. Together, these designs significantly reduce denoising steps while maintaining performance. UniWAM achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across multiple evaluations, including in-distribution performance, robustness, generalization, instruction following, and long-horizon task execution. Furthermore, we uncover a log-linear scaling law of unified human-robot co-training, demonstrating the effectiveness of large-scale pre-training on a mixture of human and robot data.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In our hypothetical graduate seminar on embodied intelligence, today's lecture is on UniWAM: Unified World-Action Model. Recent work such as Qwen-VLA and Motus reflects a field moving toward models that connect perception, prediction, and robot control. UniWAM, developed by a team including researchers affiliated with Hong Kong University of Science and Technology in Guangzhou and OLA Dimensions, asks how to combine language reasoning with learned physical dynamics. That matters because robots need both to understand instructions and to anticipate what actions will do. Yes, Noah?
segments.zh: 在我们假想的具身智能研究生研讨课上，今天的讲座主题是UniWAM：统一世界-动作模型。最近的一些工作，比如Qwen-VLA和Motus，反映出这个领域正朝着把感知、预测和机器人控制连接起来的模型方向发展。UniWAM由一支包括广州香港科技大学和OLA Dimensions研究人员的团队开发，它要解决的问题是如何把语言推理和学习到的物理动力学结合起来。这一点很重要，因为机器人既需要理解指令，也需要预判动作会带来什么结果。好，Noah，你有什么问题？

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, what is the central difference between UniWAM and a typical vision-language-action model?
segments.zh: 教授您好，UniWAM和典型的视觉-语言-动作模型之间的核心区别是什么？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: A typical vision-language-action model, or V-L-A, maps visual observations and instructions toward actions. UniWAM adds an explicit account of how the scene may change: it predicts future visual states while also reasoning in language and generating actions. The key idea is not simply to attach a video predictor to a policy. The model trains these capabilities together, letting their representations exchange information, while using different kinds of data to supervise different capabilities.
segments.zh: 典型的视觉-语言-动作模型，也就是V-L-A，是把视觉观察和指令映射到动作上。UniWAM则额外显式地刻画了场景可能如何变化：它在用语言推理、生成动作的同时，还会预测未来的视觉状态。关键不在于简单地把一个视频预测器接到策略上，而是让模型把这些能力放在一起训练，让它们的表征互相交换信息，同时用不同类型的数据去监督不同的能力。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: what are the model's parts, and what does each one do?
segments.zh: 快速问一下：这个模型由哪些部分组成，每部分各自负责什么？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: UniWAM has three specialized components. A physical reasoner handles language and scene understanding; a world generator predicts future visual information; and an action predictor produces robot motion. They use joint multimodal attention, so information can flow across components. Think of them as three experts sharing a workspace: one interprets the situation, one sketches what might happen next, and one proposes a movement. Their separation also lets the training process assign the right learning task to each expert.
segments.zh: UniWAM有三个专门组件。物理推理器负责语言和场景理解，世界生成器预测未来的视觉信息，动作预测器生成机器人运动。它们使用联合多模态注意力，所以信息可以在组件之间流动。可以把它们想象成共享一个工作空间的三个专家：一个解读当前情况，一个勾勒接下来可能发生什么，一个提出动作方案。它们的分离也让训练过程能把合适的学习任务分配给每个专家。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The training mixture combines robot demonstrations, human egocentric videos, and visual question-answering examples. Robot data supplies embodiment-specific observations and action labels, so it trains all three components. Human videos provide varied examples of interactions and resulting state changes, but not precise robot commands; they train the reasoner and world generator. Question-answering examples support scene understanding and language reasoning. In this way, the model can learn from human experience without treating a person's movement as a calibrated robot trajectory.
segments.zh: 训练数据混合了机器人演示、人类第一视角视频和视觉问答样本。机器人数据提供特定具身形态的观测和动作标签，因此能训练全部三个组件。人类视频提供丰富多样的交互示例和随之产生的状态变化，但不包含精确的机器人指令，所以用来训练推理器和世界生成器。问答样本则支持场景理解和语言推理。这样一来，模型就能从人类经验中学习，而不必把人的动作当作校准过的机器人轨迹来处理。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How does the paper represent human movement in a form the robot can use?
segments.zh: 这篇论文是如何把人类动作表示成机器人能用的形式的？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The authors describe local end-effector motion in what they call physical language: structured text about direction, displacement, rotation, and gripper state. Shared templates give human and robot examples a common motion vocabulary. The physical reasoner learns to produce these descriptions as language, while the action predictor separately learns continuous trajectories. The analogy is a translation layer: movement becomes legible to the language model, but the robot still receives its control through a dedicated action output.
segments.zh: 作者把末端执行器的局部运动用一种他们称为“物理语言”的方式描述出来：也就是关于方向、位移、旋转和夹爪状态的结构化文本。共享模板让人和机器人的示例拥有了一套共同的运动词汇。物理推理器学会把这些描述生成为语言，而动作预测器则单独学习连续轨迹。这就像一层翻译：运动变得能被语言模型读懂，但机器人仍然通过专门的动作输出获得控制指令。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The data pipelines matter too. Robot demonstrations are screened for abrupt trajectory anomalies, timing inconsistencies, numerical outliers, and some mismatches between joint states and end-effector poses. Invalid visual observations are removed, with care not to discard frames essential to an interaction. For lengthy human videos, the EgoANT pipeline proposes manipulation-event boundaries and refines them in local windows, then generates and selects descriptions. These steps aim to turn heterogeneous raw recordings into more consistent supervision.
segments.zh: 数据管线也很关键。机器人演示数据会经过筛查，剔除轨迹突变、时间不一致、数值异常，以及一些关节状态和末端执行器位姿不匹配的情况。无效的视觉观测会被移除，同时注意不丢掉对交互至关重要的帧。对于较长的人类视频，EgoANT 管线会先提出操作事件边界，再在局部窗口内细化，然后生成并筛选描述。这些步骤的目的是把来源各异的原始录像变成更一致的监督信号。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Could you clarify how the model avoids depending too much on perfect future predictions?
segments.zh: 你能说明一下，模型是如何避免过度依赖完美的未来预测的吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: During post-training, future-frame noise augmentation sometimes perturbs predicted future visual latents while leaving the current observation clean. That encourages the action predictor to remain useful when its imagined future is imperfect. The authors also change how action generation begins: history-conditioned flow matching starts from a slightly perturbed chunk of previously executed actions, then refines it toward the next chunk. Instead of beginning from random noise every time, the model can use recent behavior as a practical starting point.
segments.zh: 在后训练阶段，未来帧噪声增强有时会扰动预测出的未来视觉潜变量，同时保持当前观测干净。这促使动作预测器在其想象出的未来不完美时仍能保持有用。作者还改变了动作生成的起点：以历史为条件的流匹配从一小段被轻微扰动的、此前已执行的动作出发，然后将其细化到下一个动作块。模型不再每次都从随机噪声开始，而是可以把近期行为作为一个实用的起点。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Does that initialization mainly improve speed, or does it also affect action quality?
segments.zh: 这种初始化主要是提升速度，还是也会影响动作质量？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The paper reports benefits for both inference efficiency and performance. On RoboTwin 2.0, UniWAM achieves a mean success rate of 71.73% across clean and randomized evaluations, with a 6.82 percentage-point drop from the clean setting to the randomized one. On LIBERO, it reports 99.2% mean success. The results suggest that history-based initialization can support strong action generation with fewer refinement steps, though benchmark success alone does not establish reliable behavior in every physical setting.
segments.zh: 论文报告了推理效率和性能两方面的提升。在RoboTwin 2.0上，UniWAM在干净和随机化评估中的平均成功率为71.73%，从干净设置到随机化设置下降了6.82个百分点。在LIBERO上，它报告了99.2%的平均成功率。结果表明，基于历史的初始化能够以更少的精炼步骤支持强动作生成，不过仅凭基准成功率并不能保证在每个物理环境中都有可靠的行为。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: For robustness, the LIBERO-Plus evaluation varies factors such as camera view, language, lighting, background, sensor noise, and layout. UniWAM reports 92.6% overall success and leads on several, but not all, individual perturbation dimensions. In real-world tests on a dual-arm AgileX Piper setup, it averages 67.5% task success and 82.5% instruction-following rate across four tasks. That second measure asks whether the robot chose the intended object and interaction, even when it did not finish the manipulation.
segments.zh: 在鲁棒性方面，LIBERO-Plus 评估改变了相机视角、语言、光照、背景、传感器噪声和布局等因素。UniWAM 报告了 92.6% 的总体成功率，并在多个但并非全部单项扰动维度上领先。在双臂 AgileX Piper 平台的真实世界测试中，它在四项任务上平均达到 67.5% 的任务成功率和 82.5% 的指令遵循率。第二项指标衡量的是机器人是否选择了预期的物体和交互方式，即使它没有完成操作。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: The real-world study is fairly small; how should we interpret its instruction-following result?
segments.zh: 这项真实世界研究规模比较小，我们该怎么理解它的指令遵循结果呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: It separates understanding the request from completing a physical task. A robot may identify the right object and attempt the requested interaction but fail because of grasping or execution. UniWAM's instruction-following score captures the first part, while task success requires the whole sequence. In a desk-tidying task described only as “Tidy up the desk,” it earns an average progress score of 5 out of 6. That is evidence of multi-step capability in this setup, not proof of general household competence.
segments.zh: 它把理解指令和完成物理任务区分开来。机器人可能识别出了正确的物体，也尝试了所要求的交互，但因为抓取或执行失败而没能完成。UniWAM的指令遵循得分捕捉的是前一部分，而任务成功则需要整个流程都跑通。在一个只被描述为“整理桌子”的桌面整理任务中，它拿到了平均6分里5分的进度分。这只能说明它在这个设定下具备多步能力，并不能证明它有了通用的家务能力。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The broader connection is to work that joins action with world prediction, including Motus, and to V-L-A systems such as Qwen-VLA that unify action outputs across tasks and embodiments. UniWAM emphasizes a different training balance: human video contributes interaction dynamics, robot demonstrations anchor control, and question-answering data strengthens semantic understanding. Its scaling results suggest human data becomes more helpful as robot data grows, rather than providing consistent gains at every scale. This makes data allocation part of the model design, not merely a preprocessing choice.
segments.zh: 更广泛的联系在于把动作与世界预测结合起来的研究，比如Motus，以及像Qwen-VLA这样把动作输出跨任务、跨具身统一起来的V-L-A系统。UniWAM强调的是另一种训练平衡：人类视频贡献交互动态，机器人演示锚定控制，问答数据增强语义理解。它的规模化结果表明，随着机器人数据增长，人类数据会变得更有帮助，而不是在每个规模上都带来稳定增益。这让数据分配成为模型设计的一部分，而不只是预处理阶段的一个选择。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So does this establish that human video will improve robot learning as datasets keep growing?
segments.zh: 那么，这是否就能证明，随着数据集不断增长，人类视频会持续提升机器人学习的效果呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Not yet. The paper reports that human data begins to help around 1,000 hours of robot data in the tested settings, with larger gains at larger scales. That is a useful trend, but it does not show that the relationship continues indefinitely or transfers to every robot. The evaluation spans named simulation benchmarks and a limited real-world platform and task set. Different embodiments, longer deployments, and less structured environments remain important tests. The reported robot-data totals also differ between sections, so the scale figures deserve careful reading.
segments.zh: 还没有。论文报告说，在测试的设定下，人类数据大约在1000小时的机器人数据之后开始起作用，规模越大收益越明显。这是一个有用的趋势，但它并不能说明这种关系会无限持续下去，或者能迁移到所有机器人上。评估覆盖了一些具名的仿真基准，以及一个有限的实际平台和任务集。不同的具身形态、更长时间的部署，以及更非结构化的环境，仍然是重要的测试。论文不同章节报告的机器人数据总量也不一致，所以那些规模数字值得仔细阅读。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: What is the most important takeaway for researchers designing embodied foundation models?
segments.zh: 对于设计具身基础模型的研究者来说，最重要的启示是什么？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: UniWAM shows one way to train semantic reasoning, future-state prediction, and robot action within a shared framework, while respecting what each data source can reliably teach. Its physical-language representation links human and robot interactions; its selective supervision avoids pretending that every video contains precise robot commands; and its post-training changes address imperfect predictions and inference cost. The central research question it leaves us with is how far this combination generalizes across tasks and embodiments. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: UniWAM展示了一种在共享框架内训练语义推理、未来状态预测和机器人动作的方法，同时尊重每种数据源能够可靠传授的内容。它的物理语言表示将人类与机器人的交互联系起来；它的选择性监督避免了假装每段视频都包含精确的机器人指令；它的后训练改动解决了预测不完美和推理成本的问题。它留给我们的核心研究问题是：这种组合能在多大程度上泛化到不同任务和不同具身形态上。感谢收听。如果还有进一步的问题，可以询问我们的AI助手或留言评论。
